items.standfirst: New species of wild feline was discovered in Bolivia’s Yungas forest that is smaller than the average domestic ⁠catA diminutive wild cat that inhabits Bolivia’s ⁠cloud forest has been identified as a previously unknown species, marking the first time a new living feline species has been formally named and described in more than a century.The cat, called tilcayo by local communities, is part of a group called tiger ⁠cats found across much of South ⁠America. items.standfirst: A British man who has been detained in India for nearly nine years without conviction has been granted bail - but must remain in the country facing trial over alleged terror offences.

items.title: Deaths of nine women in South Africa could be 'linked to serial killer', police say
items.standfirst: The bodies of nine women have been found in South Africa in just two months - sparking a major police investigation into whether the deaths are linked.
